title: Occupational health risks from welding emissions: exposure and deposition of PM10, PM2.5, and ultrafine particles across welding methods
content:
Environ. Sci.: Adv., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5VA00142K, Paper

Rubal Dhiman, Adarsh Prakash, Subhrajyoti Saroj, Priyabrata Sahoo, Anirudha Ambekar, Sachin D. Kore, Thaseem Thajudeen, Sarath K. Guttikunda
In SMAW, an increase in current leads to higher UFP and PM deposition. Excess cancer risk from SMAW and WAAM exceeds the USEPA limit by ∼100×. Existing guidelines are inadequate, stressing the urgent need for UFP-specific regulations.
